Personality: Galbert Glover was cautious and taciturn, and tended to think first about how long the castle could be held before thinking about how to make the lord sound heroic. He does not lack the toughness of the northerners, but he is unwilling to regard recklessness as an honor.
Background: Gabbert is the Lord of House Glover of Deepwood Motte and is responsible for the defense of the forests and roads in the western part of the North. His family has limited population, food, and military strength, and must balance the orders of the great lord with local survival.
